tara (Finance AR): FYI: invoice & PO cutoff for this monthwe're adjusting the vendor invoice cutoff to MAY 3 17:00 PT to ensure posting before month-end close. Please escalate anything urgent.
tara (Finance AR): Key points: 1) All vendor invoices must be in Coupa by cutoff or they'll be processed next cycle. 2) POs requested after MAY 3 may not be approved until after close unless marked urgent.
kevin (Ops): Quick Q: a vendor emailed an invoice yesterday but we havent received the formal PDF. Does an email invoice count if we upload to Coupa?
tara (Finance AR): If you can upload the vendor PDF to Coupa before 17:00 PT it's fine. Email screenshots are okay temporarily but must be followed by the vendor PDF within 2 business days.
ishita (Product): Our contract renewal vendor requires final invoice sign-off by May 2 to avoid service interruption. Can we get an exception?
tara (Finance AR): For renewals that impact production, mark the PO request "procurement:close-exception" and include the renewal date + short risk note. Procurement will fast-track. Expect a 12hour triage during business hours.
ryan (Eng): we have an infra spend of $4,800 tied to an emergency fix. How do we get that cleared quickly?
tara (Finance AR): For emergency infra spend: 1) Create PO with "infra-emergency" tag, 2) DM me the thread + attach logs/incident link, 3) Procurement can provision a temporary charge and follow up with formal PO after close.
procure-bot: Automation: Coupa invoice upload -> https://coupa.redwood/invoice-upload | Procurement playbook: https://confluence.redwood/procurement/playbook#cutoffs
kevin (Ops): Are virtual-card charges still allowed during close? We had one land on the team card that needs recharging to a client project.
tara (Finance AR): Virtual-card use is allowed but please include the intended recharge code in Concur at time of charge. If the mapping isn't available by cutoff, charge will be posted to the team and reconciled in the next sweep. Use "recharge-urgent" for client-billable items and tag @tara.
ishita (Product): Any change to micro-purchase thresholds? We have a $2,200 trial that needs clearance this week.
tara (Finance AR): Thresholds unchanged. For $2,200 submit a fast-track PO and mark "priority-close". If it's truly time-sensitive, include a short justification and we'll triage within 24h.
ryan (Eng): thanks, filing the infra-emergency PO now.
kevin (Ops): uploading vendor PDF now.
tara (Finance AR): I'll post a 1-page checklist in #general: 1) Upload invoices to Coupa before MAY 3 17:00 PT. 2) Mark urgent exceptions with tags above. 3) Virtual-card: include recharge code. 4) Emergency infra: tag me + attach incident.
procure-bot: Note: "Invoices received after cutoff will be processed next month unless exception approved."
tara (Finance AR): If anyone expects late invoices from key customers or key vendors, DM me and we'll coordinate. Thanks all. :wave:
